about: Sonar Campaign: Tactics missions vs Zero-Bot, unlocked one by one. level = Zero-Bot's level, bot_mk = its powers' Mk. fog = sinking a ship doesn't show the water around it. silent = every Zero-Bot ship hides from pings and radar. bot_mines = mines Zero-Bot hides. crates = [in your sea, in Zero-Bot's sea]. bot_shields = shields Zero-Bot starts with. no_powers = you have no ship powers. move_limit = lose if you haven't won after this many moves. Stars: win, win within star_moves moves, win without losing a ship. Each new star pays star_coins x the mission number once.

ops.name: Shakedown
ops.brief: A first patrol against an easy Zero-Bot. Try every ship power.

ops.name: Fog Bank
ops.brief: Thick fog: sinking a ship no longer shows the water around it.

ops.name: Minefield
ops.brief: Zero-Bot has hidden 6 mines. Every one you hit shows it where one of your ships is.

ops.name: Supply Run
ops.brief: 6 supply crates hide in Zero-Bot's sea. Grab them before it sinks you.

ops.name: Short on Ammo
ops.brief: Only 45 moves of ammo: win before you run out.

ops.name: Silent Fleet
ops.brief: Every Zero-Bot ship runs silent: pings and radar hear nothing.

ops.name: Powerless
ops.brief: Your ships' powers are out of action. Zero-Bot's are not.

ops.name: Iron Hull
ops.brief: Zero-Bot starts with 2 shields: its first two hits bounce off.

ops.name: Last Stand
ops.brief: Master Zero-Bot with Mk III powers, and only 50 moves to beat it.

ops.name: Iron Admiral
ops.brief: The boss: Master Zero-Bot, Mk III powers, fog, 6 mines and 2 shields.
